title: BASS-II PMMA sheets • curated report subset
location: NASA/TM-20210011385, Table 5.1, printed p. 57; experimental setup §5.3, printed p. 56
method: Manually transcribed from NASA NTRS indexed Table 5.1. Semicolon arrays preserve the published velocity/spread pairing and order. Blank spread cells mean Not tracked, not zero. Material and opposed-flow geometry derive from section 5.3. No raw-video-derived measurements.
verification: Checked against NASA indexed table text. The 40 initial and final O2 values also match NASA's own PSI-25 experimental table (demo_fixtures/psi-25-experimental-table.json, checked by test/psi.test.mjs). Independent scientific review and PDF visual verification of the other columns are pending.
limitations: All 20 rows belong to one investigation and one report; they are not 20 independent studies.
Initial and final oxygen values describe test endpoints, not constant or per-segment concentrations.
Measurement uncertainty, pressure, temperature and raw media linkage are not provided by this subset.
Reported physical velocities are used; instrument display readings are not converted into velocity.
Dataset DOI identifies PSI-25. These numerical records were transcribed from the cited report, not downloaded from the PSI raw archive.
